name: git-relay
description: On-demand Git worktree coordination and branch monitoring for Codex and OpenCode.

interface.longDescription: Enable GitRelay for a requested parallel-development session, receive relevant changes and messages, and inspect branch status. Sessions default off; automatic branch synchronization is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Enable GitRelay for parallel development in this session.
Monitor branch changes with automatic synchronization disabled.
Explain GitRelay commands and safe branch synchronization.
